# payments-sdk (vendored)

This directory is a verbatim copy of Tessaract Payments' `payments-sdk` **v2.3.1**, imported unmodified.

**Do not modify any file in this directory.**

Our PCI DSS assessment diffs `vendor/payments_sdk/` against the vendor's signed v2.3.1 release every quarter.
Any local change fails that check and has to be reported to the assessor as an unapproved change to
cardholder-data code, so changes here need sign-off from the assessor first.

If something in here needs to change, open a ticket with the payments platform team (@payments-platform,
tracking ticket OPS-2207) and we will request a patched release from the vendor. Until then, leave these
files as they are.

— Payments Platform, last reviewed 2026-03-02
